headline: Long-range planning kicks off; West Somerville Neighborhood School students return to their building.
summary: Students in the building moved back to their regular rooms, and SCALE students return to the West on Wednesday. Long-range planning questionnaires are due November 16, and schematic design for the new school building is due around February 24th. Members also approved grants, including $694,752 for the Commonwealth Preschool Partnership, and a revised school calendar, and they tabled the Section B policy changes.
decisions: Tabled approval of most of the Somerville Public School Policy Manual, Section B, until the next November meeting.
Approved a revised school year '27 calendar with a noon dismissal at the West Somerville Neighborhood School on January 4th, 2027.
Approved federal and state continuation grants for Somerville Public Schools, including $694,752 for the Commonwealth Preschool Partnership.
discussion: Long-range planning process: Members discussed how to set new district goals. The questionnaire is due November 16, workshops will follow, and draft goals are due in January, with a vote by February. Some members said the board should set three to five goals and asked for student and family feedback.

Return to the West building: Members thanked district staff, city departments, the PTA, and teachers for the return after flooding. Members said an after-action review of the continuity of operations plan is planned soon.

Multilingual learner review: The director of the Multilingual Learner Education Department said ACCESS progress rose to 44% of students in school year '25-'26, up from 33%. Members asked about former English learners and tier one instruction, and a state review report is expected this winter.

School Committee goals update: The presentation showed progress on four past goals, such as Grade 3 DIBELS results at or above benchmark, up to 68% from 62%, against a 75% target. Members asked for grades 3 through 8 data and a later report on the enrollment-informed staffing model.

decision_evidence.quote: All right. We consider the motion tabled until our next November meeting.

Chair, I move to approve the revised school year '27 school calendar to include a noon dismissal for WSNS on January 4th, 2027, as a makeup day for the October 13th school closure. ... That motion passes.

I move to accept all federal entitlement and continuation grants, and all state continuation grants awarded to the Somerville Public Schools, uh listed as follows: Bristol Myers Squibb for districtwide, uh $15,000, ... All those in favor, aye. All opposed, any abstentions? The motion passes.
